typeDesc.A: Large network; can take any single leg, e.g. line-haul on busy lanes. Connects by API; paid per leg.
typeDesc.B: Strong in one city or region; first and last mile. Partner App or API; paid per shipment handled.
typeDesc.C: Last mile and same-city pickups. Partner App; paid per delivery.
typeDesc.D: Trucks between hubs (line-haul). Partner App with GPS / FASTag; paid per trip or per kg on the lane.
typeDesc.E: Consolidation and PTL line-haul; a hub if you have one. Portal and API; paid per kg with a minimum.
typeDesc.F: Sorting, consolidation, de-consolidation and short storage. Hub scanning app; paid per piece / kg plus storage per day.
